sources.elevation: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE DTM Mosaic, 1 m/pixel (Fergason et al. 2020, USGS Astrogeology, doi:10.5066/P9REJ9JN); MRO HiRISE stereo
sources.slope: Derived from elevation: 90th percentile of 5 m slopes in each 25 m cell (HiRISE DTM mosaic, doi:10.5066/P9REJ9JN)
sources.rock: Roughness proxy, not a boulder count: standard deviation of plane-detrended 1 m elevation in each cell, 1 m = 1.0 (HiRISE DTM mosaic, doi:10.5066/P9REJ9JN)
